user.title: eQ-3 MAX! Cube
user.description: Enter the IP address of your MAX! Cube LAN gateway. The MAX! smartphone app and any other client must be disconnected, because the Cube accepts only one connection at a time.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the IP address and make sure no other app is connected to the Cube.

abort.already_configured: This MAX! Cube is already configured.

reconnect.name: Reconnect
reconnect.description: Close the connection to the Cube and read everything from it again.

entry_id.name: Cube (config entry)
entry_id.description: Optional: only this Cube. Without it, all configured Cubes are reconnected.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Return the weekly heating programme of a thermostat (for each day the setpoints with the time until which each temperature applies).

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Write the same daily heating programme to the chosen days of a radiator thermostat. Each period gives the temperature that applies until the time shown; the last period must end at 24:00 (at most seven periods, times in steps of 5 minutes, temperatures in half degrees from 4.5 to 30.5). Wall thermostats cannot be programmed here.

days.name: Days
days.description: The days that get this programme (monday to sunday).

periods.name: Periods
periods.description: A list of periods, each with 'until' (HH:MM) and 'temperature'.

dry_run.name: Check only
dry_run.description: Only check the request and show what would be written; nothing is sent to the Cube.

schedule_radiator_only.message: Only radiator thermostats can be programmed here.

schedule_too_many_periods.message: At most {detail} periods per day can be written.

schedule_bad_time.message: {detail} is not a valid time (use HH:MM between 00:05 and 24:00).

schedule_time_not_in_steps.message: {detail} is not a multiple of 5 minutes.

schedule_times_not_rising.message: The times must rise from period to period ({detail} is not later than the one before).

schedule_bad_temperature.message: {detail} is not allowed: use half degrees from 4.5 to 30.5.

schedule_must_end_at_midnight.message: The last period must end at 24:00.

schedule_duty_cycle_high.message: The Cube has already used {duty} % of its radio time. Try again later.

schedule_not_written.message: The Cube did not take the programme for: {days}.

battery_low.title: Battery low: {name}
battery_low.description: The MAX! device {name} reports a low battery. Replace the batteries soon, otherwise the device stops responding and the radiator valve stays in its last position.

device_error.title: Device reports an error: {name}
device_error.description: The MAX! device {name} reports an error to the Cube. Check that it sits properly on the radiator valve, that its batteries are fine and that it is within radio range of the Cube.
